questions.questionText:
A transparent square sheet has a design:
Left half: a circle with a vertical diameter.
Right half: a circle with a horizontal diameter.
Find out how the pattern will appear when the transparent sheet is folded along the central dotted line (left half is folded over the right half along the vertical dotted line).
options: a single circle with both horizontal and vertical diameters (cross inside circle)
A circle with only the vertical diameter remaining
A circle with two parallel vertical chords
A circle divided into four quadrants with one quadrant shaded
questions.hint: Folding along a vertical axis creates a lateral mirror reflection of the folded half onto the stationary half.
questions.explanation: Folding the left half over the right half superimposes the vertical diameter onto the right circle, intersecting the horizontal diameter into a full cross (+).
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify which half is stationary and which half moves.
Step 2: Reflect the moving design across the fold line as a mirror image.
Step 3: Superimpose the reflected design onto the stationary design to obtain: a single circle with both horizontal and vertical diameters (cross inside circle).
questions.memoryTip: Paper folding is identical to superimposing the mirror image of the folded section onto the other section.

questions.questionText:
A transparent square sheet has a design:
Left half: an upward pointing equilateral triangle.
Right half: a downward pointing equilateral triangle.
Find out how the pattern will appear when the transparent sheet is folded along the central dotted line (left side is folded over the right side along the central vertical axis).
options: Two disjoint triangles touching only at their apex
a six-pointed star (hexagram) formed by the two superimposed triangles
A single upward-pointing triangle with a horizontal base line
A diamond (rhombus) formed by inverted triangular bases
questions.hint: Folding along a vertical axis creates a lateral mirror reflection of the folded half onto the stationary half.
questions.explanation: When the upward triangle on the left folds onto the downward triangle on the right, their outlines intersect to create a symmetrical six-pointed star.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Identify which half is stationary and which half moves.
Step 2: Reflect the moving design across the fold line as a mirror image.
Step 3: Superimpose the reflected design onto the stationary design to obtain: a six-pointed star (hexagram) formed by the two superimposed triangles.
questions.memoryTip: Paper folding is identical to superimposing the mirror image of the folded section onto the other section.
